* fix(security): serve KV API same-origin and drop baked-in auth token

VITE_KV_AUTH_TOKEN was inlined into the public JS bundle, making worker
auth decorative. Browser auth now rides the Cloudflare Access session
cookie on the site's own origin.

- Pages Functions forward /kv/* and /api/logs to the worker over a
  KV_API service binding
- kv-client: no Authorization header, same-origin credentials, one reload
  on 401 so Access can re-authenticate
- Add getKVBaseUrl() shared by kv-client and logger
- Remove VITE_KV_AUTH_TOKEN from types and deployment docs

Closes #322

* fix(client): address review - dev auth, reauth loop guard, SW and docs

- Dev: Vite proxies /kv and /api/logs to the local worker and injects the
  service token server-side (KV_DEV_AUTH_TOKEN, not VITE_-prefixed), so
  local dev works against the fail-closed worker without a bundled secret
- getKVBaseUrl() defaults to same origin everywhere
- 401 recovery now navigates with an access-reauth parameter and records
  the attempt in sessionStorage so a persistent 401 cannot loop; any
  non-401 response re-arms recovery and cleans the URL
- Service worker denylists the reauth navigation so Access login is not
  replaced by the offline fallback

fix(security): keep Arlo token server-side and lock down the Arlo proxy (#372)

* fix(security): keep Arlo token server-side and lock down the Arlo proxy

The Arlo bearer token sat in plaintext localStorage (readable by any XSS)
and the proxy accepted any origin, forwarded client Authorization headers
and had a placeholder production route.

Proxy (workers/arlo-proxy):
- Holds the token in its own KV namespace; PUT/GET/DELETE /session, where
  GET returns metadata only, never the secret
- Injects authorization/xcloudid/auth-version upstream and never forwards
  client credentials, cookies or Cf-* headers
- Fail-closed Access JWT check (reuses workers/src/auth.ts), ALLOWED_ORIGINS
  CORS instead of *, https://*.arlo.com only for media, no workers.dev URL,
  placeholder route removed, URLs no longer logged

Client:
- ArloTokenManager keeps only non-secret metadata in memory and uploads the
  token once; exportAsHeaders() carries no credentials
- A legacy localStorage token is uploaded with its real expiry, then deleted
- ArloAdapter, TokenRefreshModal, SecurityCameras, CameraDetailsModal and
  UniversalVideoPlayer use the same-origin /api/arlo route
- Pages Function + ARLO_PROXY service binding; Vite dev proxy for local use

Closes #323
Closes #324

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(arlo-proxy): set ARLO_SESSION KV namespace id

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(env): update env example and production config

Aligns the committed env files with the same-origin KV and Arlo routing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(arlo): address review - races, deletion, expiry and origin checks

- Serialize refresh, save and clear in ArloTokenManager so a slow refresh or
  legacy-migration upload can never overwrite newer state
- A successful manual save removes any retained legacy token; clearToken()
  removes it unconditionally, propagates server/network failures, and only
  forgets local state once the server confirms deletion
- ArloAdapter deletes the stored token only when Arlo rejected it; a
  "session missing" answer (possibly stale: KV is eventually consistent)
  prompts for a token but never deletes
- Proxy rejects an expired or malformed expiresAt with 400 instead of
  renewing it; omitted defaults to 36h, future values are clamped
- Proxy rejects unexpected Origins with 403 before dispatch (same-origin,
  ALLOWED_ORIGINS and Origin-less authenticated calls still pass); the check
  lives in workers/src/auth.ts as isOriginAllowed
- Document the KV consistency model
- Tests for each behaviour, including a mutation check of the race test

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
